Skokie, IL · Chicago area

I help small businesses automate.

If you want to automate your manual workflows and don't know how — you're in the right place.





How it works

1. We talk. We get on Zoom and you tell me how your business really runs. One conversation about your actual week. You don’t need a plan or any tech knowledge.

2. I map it. We find where your time and money are going, and pick the best first piece to automate.

3. I build it. With AI build tools, what used to take months now takes days or weeks. Your first piece is built around how your business already works.

4. You try it. Use it in your real work. Send me one round of changes, and I’ll make them and send it back.

5. You own it. Once it’s paid in full, it’s yours. I stay with you after it goes live.

6. We do it again. When the first piece is paying for itself, we pick the next one and build that. One piece at a time.
